text:
noah (FinOps): Quick alert — Zenith Labs renewal INV-2026-900 shows platform fee + reseller HSM add-on double-counted after private migration. Need corrected invoice + auditor note before month-end close.
li (Billing): can you paste the invoice snippet?
noah (FinOps): PDF lines:
```INV-2026-900
Line 2: Platform Fee - Period 01Jan2026-31Dec2026 - Amount: $180,000
Line 7: Reseller Discount (partner XYZ) - Amount: -$36,000
Line 9: HSM Add-on (vendor-managed) - Period 01Jul2026-30Jun2027 - Amount: $24,000
Line 12: Migration effective 01Jul2026 - note: prorate not applied to platform
```
rachel (CS): Customer went private 2026-07-01 per AMEND-31 (signed 2026-06-20). Reseller contract RC-772 says reseller handles HSM billing; discount applies to the customer-facing platform amount only.
diego (Sales): Confirmed. Sales ops SO-1780 requested seller-side billing for HSM. Thought billing would pick up reseller flag.
li (Billing): Investigating. Pipeline show mapping for "reseller_billed" dropped when amendment present. Filing BE-5420. For now we can issue a manual correction:
- Correct platform: pro-rate 180k for Jul-Dec (6/12) = $90,000
- Apply reseller discount 20% on pro-rated platform = 90k * 20% = $18,000 -> platform net = $72,000
- HSM (24k) should be billed to reseller, so remove $24,000 from customer invoice
Current invoice net = 180k - 36k + 24k = $168,000
Correct invoice net = $72,000
Credit required = $168k - $72k = $96,000
I'll draft credit memo with line-level arithmetic and attach AMEND-31, RC-772, SO-1780. Routing to finance for approval AR-8044.
billing-bot: New issue BE-5420 created: "reseller_billing flag ignored when amendment exists" assigned to billing-engine-team. https://issues.redwood/BE-5420
rachel (CS): I'll tell the customer we're doing a "billing alignment with reseller agreement" and will attach corrected invoice when available. Avoid language "billing error".
diego (Sales): I approve a one-off credit up to $120k for Zenith. Adding my sign-off to AR-8044.
noah (FinOps): Please include an auditor-friendly note in the credit memo showing the per-month calculation, amendment id, and reseller contract reference. Need draft today and final within 48 hours.
li (Billing): Will deliver draft credit + corrected invoice by EOD, final tomorrow morning after approvals. Will follow up when BE-5420 backfill runs to ensure automation won't re-bill.
